name: VDRL
description: VDRL (Venereal Disease Research Laboratory) test detects syphilis infection by measuring reagin antibodies in serum. This flocculation test is used for syphilis screening and monitoring.
literatureReview: VDRL test detects non-treponemal antibodies (reagins) to cardiolipin-lecithin-cholesterol antigen. Normal: non-reactive. Reactive: positive for syphilis. Quantitative results reported as titer (1:2, 1:4, etc.). Becomes positive 4-6 weeks after infection. False positives with autoimmune diseases, pregnancy, IV drug use, or recent vaccination. False negatives in early/late syphilis or prozone phenomenon. Confirm positive results with TPHA or FTA-ABS. Used for syphilis screening, treatment monitoring (4-fold titer decrease), and congenital syphilis diagnosis. Critical for STD screening and public health surveillance.
